div.div:
Every service reads the shared JWT secret through External Secrets (IRSA to AWS Secrets Manager), exports OTLP traces to Jaeger on :4317, and exposes metrics that Prometheus scrapes; frontend adds nginx counters on :9113 and :9114.
No service keeps durable data: todos live in memory, users in a pod-local H2 database, and Redis is neither persisted nor replicated.

text.tspan: Every service reads the shared JWT secret through External Secrets (IRSA to AWS Secrets Manager), exports OTLP traces to Jaeger on :4317, and exposes metrics that Prometheus
scrapes; frontend adds nginx counters on :9113 and :9114.
No service keeps durable data: todos live in memory, users in a pod-local H2 database, and Redis is neither persisted nor replicated.
